target.name: Ribosomal scanning and start codon recognition
target.description: Choosing where to begin translating is the step that decides which protein an mRNA makes, and ribosomal scanning and start codon recognition is how that choice is made. After the 43S complex loads near the capped 5' end, the small subunit tracks along the leader in the 5'-to-3' direction until the initiator methionyl-tRNA anticodon pairs with an AUG in good context, producing the 48S complex that is then committed to subunit joining.

target.name: Sialic acid metabolism
target.description: Sialic acid metabolism builds, activates, installs and recycles the negatively charged nine-carbon sugars that cap most cell-surface glycans. These terminal sialic acids determine how cells are recognised: they form the ligands for selectins and Siglecs, mask glycans from galectins and complement, carry the polysialic acid that lets developing neurons remodel their contacts, and serve as attachment sites for influenza and other pathogens.

target.description: Shaping of the foregut is the embryonic step that converts the anterior endoderm tube into the primordia of the pharynx, oesophagus, trachea and lung buds, stomach, liver and pancreas. Getting it wrong produces some of the commonest structural birth defects, including oesophageal atresia with tracheo-oesophageal fistula and congenital diaphragmatic hernia.

[untitled BTM module] These genes converge on the regulation of gene expression at the steps between transcription and protein turnover. Cyclin T2 partners CDK9 in the elongation kinase that releases paused RNA polymerase II, while cyclin C works within the Mediator kinase module that gates promoter engagement, and ARID4A and SP3 act on chromatin and promoter DNA to set which genes are read.

[untitled BTM module] This grouping centres on transcriptional repression and chromatin-based silencing, the machinery that keeps developmental and proliferative genes switched off until they are needed. Polycomb components are the anchor: BMI1 is a core subunit of the PRC1 ubiquitin ligase complex that marks histone H2A to maintain silencing, while AEBP2 is a zinc-finger accessory factor that helps target the companion PRC2 methyltransferase to chromatin.

target.name: meiotic cell cycle checkpoint signaling
target.description: Meiosis must not proceed until chromosomes have been replicated, paired, recombined and correctly attached to the spindle, and meiotic cell cycle checkpoint signaling is the surveillance that enforces that order. Its outputs are the delays that give cells time to repair double-strand breaks and to correct faulty kinetochore attachments; when the surveillance fails, gametes carry unrepaired breaks or the wrong chromosome number, a route to infertility, oocyte loss and aneuploid conceptions.
